name: Moreland 850 Shotgun
summary: Rugged, high-impact 12-gauge pump-action shotgun manufactured by Moreland, delivering devastating close-quarters stopping power.
description: Featured prominently in stash house breaches and convenience store robberies, the Moreland 850 is modeled after the legendary Remington 870. Holding up to 8 rounds in its extended tubular magazine, its buckshot spread dominates indoor CQB engagements and vehicle disablement.

seo.title: Moreland 850 Shotgun: Specs, Damage & Locations
seo.description: Full guide to the Moreland 850 Shotgun in GTA VI. Pump-action stats, spread patterns, breaching utility, and ammo capacity.
